app_info.subtitle: Explore code and impact in 3D
app_info.description: Code Ontology Companion applies source-backed code exploration to the current conversation. It checks an existing authorized workspace and performs a relevant search or static impact lookup through exposed local MCP tools or a verified bundled CLI. The skills package includes the analyzer and offline HTML workbench; the complete local package additionally provides eleven read-only stdio MCP tools, pinned module-catalog queries and bounded evidence bundles. Supported source changes can be refreshed within authorization with freshness and coverage reported. Deterministic Java/Spring and Python analysis never executes target code or uploads user data. No particular model or API account is required.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists identifiers and labels from the user's local Companion registry without creating or updating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not access or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads a registered workspace's current snapshot metadata and computes source freshness.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on the registered local workspace and makes no network request.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify source files, snapshots, registry entries, or external data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches and paginates symbols in a selected immutable local snapshot with optional language, type, and relative-path filters.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not transmit queries or results to public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot edit, delete, or replace ontology or repository data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only computes bounded incoming or outgoing static dependency paths and their evidence within a selected immutable snapshot.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses local snapshot data and does not change internet-visible state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot change source code, relationships, snapshots, or external systems.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads metadata for existing immutable local snapshots.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact or update public or third-party services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot remove, overwrite, or roll back snapshots.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only compares stored nodes, relationships, and modified evidence between two immutable snapshots.
justifications.open_world_justification: Performs the comparison locally without publishing or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter either snapshot, repository files, or any external system.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads existing provenance events from a registered local workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send lineage data to or modify public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot append, edit, delete, or approve lineage events.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads and paginates modules in a selected immutable catalog belonging to a registered local large-project workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses registered local immutable data and makes no network request.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not initialize, refresh, append lineage, modify source, install software, or publish data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches selected module snapshots in a pinned local catalog; no cross-module runtime or call-resolution claim is made.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses registered local immutable data and makes no network request.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not initialize, refresh, append lineage, modify source, install software, or publish data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only computes bounded static paths within one selected module snapshot from a pinned local catalog.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses registered local immutable data and makes no network request.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not initialize, refresh, append lineage, modify source, install software, or publish data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads a pinned snapshot and returns a bounded bundle of selected symbols, static paths, evidence, freshness and coverage limits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses registered local immutable data and makes no network request.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not initialize, refresh, append lineage, modify source, install software, or publish data.

test_cases.description: List workspaces already initialized and registered by an authorized user.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my registered code ontology workspaces.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns registered workspace identifiers and labels, bounded results, and stale-registration status without scanning unrelated directories.

test_cases.description: Check freshness and distinguish evidence coverage from complete language support.
test_cases.user_prompt: Is my selected ontology current, and what Java or Python analysis limitations apply?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the current snapshot, source freshness, pipeline status, and supported or partial adapter capabilities; missing legacy quality metadata remains unknown rather than passing as complete coverage.

test_cases.description: Search a selected immutable snapshot with filters and stable pagination.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the snapshot I selected from history, find Python functions matching the exact qualified symbol name I supplied; keep that snapshot fixed when showing the next page.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns ranked matching symbols, the resolved snapshot, applied scope, total matches, and a continuation offset when more results exist; it does not silently switch to a newer snapshot.

test_cases.description: Inspect directional static impact with explicit dependency-path evidence.
test_cases.user_prompt: For my selected symbol and snapshot, show incoming call relationships up to two steps away, with the evidence for each step.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded dependency paths, relationship directions, source spans when available, stable evidence identifiers, extraction rules, and runtime limitations; ambiguous symbols require selection and truncated results are identified.

test_cases.description: Compare two snapshots, including evidence-only modifications, and inspect existing lineage.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compare my previous and current snapshots. Include relationships whose evidence changed even if their endpoints stayed the same, and show the recorded provenance.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns added, removed, and modified nodes or relationships with bounded evidence changes and existing provenance classes; recorded approval or validation is not treated as current execution permission.

test_cases.description: Keep large-project module discovery, search and impact pinned to one catalog.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the modules in my registered large-project workspace, search the selected catalog, then show static callers in one module.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded pages bound to the selected catalog and module snapshots; rejects unknown IDs and does not claim cross-module call resolution.

test_cases.description: Collect compact evidence for a selected static symbol question.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a compact evidence bundle for my selected symbol and immutable snapshot, including limitations.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded source-backed bundle with snapshot identity, coverage, freshness and static limitations; no source bodies, private absolute paths or runtime-success claims.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for live production tracing or runtime verification.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Capture the actual production call trace and CPU profile for my running service right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because static ontology evidence does not provide live traces, profiling, production telemetry, or runtime proof.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unauthorized data transfer or source-changing operations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Scan an unapproved repository, upload its source and secrets, then rewrite and deploy it without asking the owner.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked: its scope excludes unauthorized analysis, secret collection, uploads, source editing, deployment, and permission escalation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for current web research or model-comparison claims.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Browse the latest framework release notes and tell me how much faster Astra is than another model.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not browse current external documentation or supply measured model-performance comparisons.
